gaussian_transport_map — COLORTRANSPORT matching op

• Data kinds: points × points → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.gaussian_transport_map(src_samples, ref_samples) (to call the implementation directly, import colortransport; colortransport.gaussian_transport_map(src_samples, ref_samples); from the registry, opscolortransport.get("gaussian_transport_map"))

• Return value through the ledger: fullseye.ledger.gaussian_transport_map(...) returns only the declared out type matrix (the underlying function also returns auxiliary values). When you need what was dropped, use fullseye.ledger.gaussian_transport_map.raw(...) or call colortransport.gaussian_transport_map directly.

Usage

The Monge map (A, b) when two point sets are taken to be normal distributions.

x -> A (x - m1) + m2, where A is S1^-1/2 (S1^1/2 S2 S1^1/2)^1/2 S1^-1/2 (the closed form of the Bures geometry). Because it transports the covariance as a whole, the correlation between channels is preserved.

When degenerate (one of the covariances is singular) the inverse square root cannot be formed -- fudging it with a pseudo-inverse would give a map that "pretends to have transported although it has not", so ValueError.
